variable_height_notes.FR-Capitole: Observation height varied depending on windspeed. All observations at lowest tower position (~27m) excluded, with wind speed corrected using log laws, following Goret et al. (2019) https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aeaoa.2019.100042. Gap-filling from local observations by CNRM. ERA5 snowfall set to zero during analysis period per advice from CNRM.
